name: South Lyon
seo_title: South Lyon Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in South Lyon, Michigan for 2026: 4 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: South Lyon packs its Christmas into one December Saturday, with a candy cane hunt, a village celebration and a lighted parade that brings Santa to town.
celebrates: South Lyon's big day is Saturday, December 5, 2026. It starts with a 10 am Candy Cane Hunt at McHattie Park and the 38th Annual Holiday Shop at South Lyon High School, continues with Christmas at the Village at the South Lyon Area Historical Society, and ends with the 6 pm Holiday Spectacular Parade, Santa's arrival at the Witches Hat Depot and the lighting of the Village tree. On December 11 the South Lyon Area Recreation Authority adds Milk and Cookies with Santa.
lastyear: Downtown South Lyon's Holiday Spectacular has carried the same plan for years: the parade, Santa's arrival and the lighting of the Village tree, according to the downtown events page. This year's Holiday Shop is the 38th, so last year's was the 37th, and the Historical Society's page says Santa will be back to light the Village tree and hear the children's Christmas requests.
facts: The Holiday Spectacular parade ends at the South Lyon Witches Hat Museum Depot on Dorothy Street, where Santa is presented with the Key to the City by Mayor Steve Kennedy and lights the Village tree. Trophies are awarded to float winners. The Kiwanis Christmas tree sale runs through the final weekend, and the new Lyon's Mane Stage theatre group performs in the Little Village Chapel.
trains: South Lyon's parade ends at the Witches Hat Depot, a depot museum at the Historical Society's village at 300 Dorothy Street, which is a nod to the town's railroad past. For rides, Amtrak's Wolverine route serves Royal Oak and Troy, the closest stations, and the Greenfield Village Railroad in Dearborn is a bigger day trip. Rally also keeps a statewide guide to Michigan Christmas train rides.
traditions: A 6 pm lighted parade from School Street to Dorothy Street.
Santa gets the Key to the City and lights the Village tree.
A 10 am hunt at McHattie Park for kids 12 and under.
Stage shows, baked goods and Santa at the Historical Society.
The 38th annual shop at South Lyon High School.
kidfact: Santa gets the Key to the City from the mayor in South Lyon before he lights the Village tree.
faq: How does South Lyon celebrate Christmas?

With a December 5 lineup of a Candy Cane Hunt, the Holiday Shop at the high school, Christmas at the Village and the Holiday Spectacular Parade. Santa arrives at the Witches Hat Depot at 6:30 pm, receives the Key to the City and lights the Village tree.
When is the South Lyon Christmas parade?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, at 6 pm, with lineup at 5 pm at Bartlett Elementary on School Street. It ends on Dorothy Street at the Witches Hat Depot.
Where can kids meet Santa in South Lyon?
At Washburn School at 6:45 pm on December 5, after he lights the tree, and at Milk and Cookies with Santa on December 11.
Is there a candy cane hunt in South Lyon?
Yes, at McHattie Park at 10 am on December 5, for kids 12 and under. It is listed on this page.
What is the Witches Hat Depot?
It is the South Lyon Witches Hat Museum Depot at 300 Dorothy Street, where the parade ends and the Historical Society holds Christmas at the Village.
